newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-LAKERS SEND CEBALLOS, ROBINSON TO SUNS FOR HORRY, KLEINE.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-LAKERS SEND CEBALLOS, ROBINSON TO SUNS FOR HORRY, KLEINE.

text.p: The Los Angeles Lakers on Friday shipped high-scoring forward Cedric Ceballos and point guard Rumeal Robinson to the Phoenix Suns in exchange for disgruntled forward Robert Horry and centre Joe Kleine.
Ceballos, who began his career in Phoenix, averaged 21 points per game in each of the last two seasons.
He has played in just eight games this season after suffering a partial tear of the patella tendon in his right knee on November 13, but is expected to return to action shortly.
Ceballos should provide the struggling Suns with a much-need offensive boost. The emergence of Eddie Jones and rookie Kobe Bryant in the Lakers lineup made the injured forward expendable.
"We are very pleased to be able to add a player like Cedric to our current mix," said Suns coach Danny Ainge. "His scoring provides us with an exciting complement to the play-making of Jason Kidd."
The Suns acquired point guard Jason Kidd from Dallas last month.
Horry was sent packing by Phoenix shortly after being suspended for two games for throwing a towel in Ainge's face on the bench during a game.

A key player in the Suns' off-season deal that sent Charles Barkley to Houston, Horry was unable to fit into Phoenix's offensive scheme. He is averaging just 6.9 points and 3.7 rebounds in 32 games this season.
"Robert ... is very athletic as well as being a good three-point shooter and, most of all, is an excellent defensive player," said Lakers general manager Mitch Kupchak.

Robinson was averaging just three points per game in 15 contests for the Lakers but is a six-year veteran who will provide backup depth for the Suns, who already have Kevin Johnson, Steve Nash and Kidd at the point.
Kleine, a 12-year veteran, will play backup behind Lakers star centre Shaquille O'Neal. He has played in 23 games this season, averaging 3.4 points and 3.5 rebounds.
